title: THE TOWER · DESCENDING FLOORS
vibe: 45 min · green · hard · 5 floors, 300 reps, one clock, every floor exits onto a fartlek leg
why: The Tower is your highest-rated session and it has been 22 days: one descending list, one clock, big pull and press volume. Legs only run today after four straight loaded-leg days, and the legs alternate float and surge.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 6 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day C flow + shoulder and elbow prep

items.name: Elbow circles ×10/dir · empty-bell curl + press ×10
items.detail: prime the elbows for the curl floors

items.name: Belt 5.5 mph @ 0% · 2 min
items.detail: then set 6.5 for the first leg

blocks.title: THE TOWER · CAP 28:00
blocks.meta: 5 FLOORS · 20 / 16 / 12 / 8 / 4 PER STATION · 300 REPS · 2×40 lb · 50 lb
blocks.format: For time. At each floor run all 5 stations at that floor's number, then the leg, then drop a floor. Count floors descended.
blocks.workRest: Legs are 0.20 mi. F20 → 6.5 · F16 → 8.5 · F12 → 6.5 · F8 → 8.5 · F4 → 9.0. Float, surge, float, surge, finish.

items.name: FARTLEK LEG · 0.20 mi — then drop a floor

blocks.noteGreen: Log floors descended at 28:00, finish time if you get to the ground floor, RPE, and which station ate the clock.
blocks.text: ★ CROSS-BODY ROW — pull the bell across to the opposite hip, ribs down. ★ PUSH PRESS — quick knee bend, drive, lock out overhead. ★ SHRUG — straight up, squeeze, no rolling. ★ SURGE LEG — step on moving, short quick stride.
